parameters.query: SELECT topic_id, title, angle, direction, keywords, brief FROM topics WHERE topic_id = '{{ $json.topic_id }}'
SELECT url, note AS title, content FROM topic_sources WHERE topic_id = '{{ $json.topic_id }}'
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'DEEPSEEK_API_KEY'), '') AS value
INSERT INTO drafts (topic_id, outline, body_md, status) VALUES ('{{ $json.topic_id }}', '{{ $json.outline_s }}', '{{ $json.body_md_s }}', 'drafting') RETURNING id, topic_id, status;
